Es gibt zwei Formen des Energieausweises: There are two types of energy certificate: the consumption certificate and the demand certificate. The consumption certificate is based on the residents' measured and documented energy use over the past three years. The demand certificate, by contrast, requires a full analysis of the building. Heat losses are calculated from factors such as the quality and insulation of the building envelope, exterior walls, ceilings and windows. The heating system and other technical elements are also taken into account. A valid energy certificate can only be issued by specially trained and qualified experts.
